hypothesis: Putting the real PDF upload-to-editable-map flow and a page-verifiable fixed sample on the ranking URL will improve search-intent satisfaction and make the tool page, rather than the tutorial, Google's preferred page for transactional PDF queries.
variableGroup: On-page task completion and verifiable product evidence
changesAllowed: Embedded PDF selection and generation flow on the target URL
Fixed public PDF sample and page-reference verification section
Truthful limits, editing/export proof and method comparison
Funnel events required to measure the same experience
primaryMetrics: Target page impressions for the PDF transactional query cluster
Average and median position by query, page, country and device
Google-selected page for the exact query
guardrails: No canonical, robots, hreflang or schema regression
No material LCP or INP regression
No user document content, file name or PII in analytics
stoppingRule: Observe for at least 21 days and until the PDF cluster gains at least 50 new impressions, using the later condition.
attributionLimitation: Both target pages are planned for the same deployment window. Page-specific effects can be compared, but shared site-level or algorithmic movement cannot be fully attributed to either intervention without the frozen control page.

evaluationSchedule.day0: Record deployment ID and capture after-deployment snapshots
evaluationSchedule.day7: Check crawl/indexation, page ownership and funnel leading indicators; do not decide ranking outcome
evaluationSchedule.day21: Earliest directional ranking review if the PDF cluster has at least 50 new impressions
evaluationSchedule.day28OrLater: Preferred keep/rollback decision when page ownership and guardrails are stable

nextAction: Deploy round 1, record the deployment ID, then begin the 21-day/50-impression observation window.
